title.zh: v2.0.14 GS-1 接线第一块：按帧寻址的调度核心（含延迟补偿与 8 复音上限），默认关闭、行为零变化
title.en: v2.0.14 GS-1 wiring, part one: the frame-addressed scheduling core (latency compensation and an 8-voice ceiling), off by default, zero behaviour change

highlights.zh: **新增 `src/audio/gs1/gs1Tracks.ts`（P6 Phase 2 的调度核心）**：把音高/时间/时长/力度翻译成**按帧寻址**的 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt`，并**减去 worklet 报告的 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`**——这一步就是「在拍上」和「每个音晚 2.7 ms」的全部差别，而且实时与离线必须完全一致，所以它被放进纯函数、由 13 条测试锁定（秒→帧换算、延迟补偿、首块不排到过去、顺序确定、力度夹紧、非法输入返回 null）。另含 **`capPlanPolyphony`**：超过 **8 复音**（E3 实测上限）时**丢最旧的音**——丢尾巴听起来是变薄，丢新音听起来是和弦卡住。
highlights.en: **New `src/audio/gs1/gs1Tracks.ts` (the P6 Phase 2 scheduling core)**: it turns pitch/time/duration/velocity into **frame-addressed** `noteAt`/`noteOffAt`, **subtracting the worklet-reported `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`** — that subtraction is the entire difference between \"in the pocket\" and \"every note 2.7 ms late\", and live and offline must agree on it exactly, so it lives in a pure function pinned by 13 tests (seconds-to-frames, latency compensation, never scheduling…

highlights.zh: **默认关闭（重要）**：打开它会**改变绝大多数曲风的听感**（换合成器、换 patch），而这些 patch 从未做过听感对比，本仓库也无法测量「更好听」。默认开启等于用一次没人验证过的判断改动 159 个曲风，并让音色基线作废。因此开关是**有意的动作**，代价（重测响度 + 音色 + 重配 trim）明确写在模块头与计划 §5.14 里。**本版没有任何一轨的声音发生变化。**
highlights.en: **Off by default (and that matters).** Enabling it **changes how most genres sound** (different synthesis, different patches), and those patches have never been judged by ear — this repository cannot measure \"sounds better\". Shipping it enabled would change 159 genres on an unverified judgement and invalidate the measured timbre baseline. The switch is therefore a deliberate act, with its cost (re-measure loudness and timbre, re-fit trims) stated in the module header and p…

highlights.zh: **所有失败路径都返回 `null`（= 用原生引擎）**：未接线的角色（kick/snare/hihat/percussion/bass/fx）、没有 GS-1 patch 的乐器（钢琴、西塔琴、长笛、颤音琴等**有意保留原生**的原声乐器）、非法采样率、空音列表、全零力度。另外修掉上一轮的 fast 轨崩溃：GS-1 运行时资源（worklet + 两个 wasm）改为 `public/gs1/` 静态提供，同步脚本自动发布、门禁断言与 pin **逐字节相同**（契约门禁 22 → 25 项）。
highlights.en: **Every failure path returns `null` (= use the native engine)**: roles GS-1 does not voice (kick/snare/hihat/percussion/bass/fx), instruments with no GS-1 patch (piano, sitar, flute, vibraphone and the other acoustic instruments **deliberately kept native**), a nonsense sample rate, an empty note list, or all-zero velocities.
